objective: Evaluate whether MLLMs can bind visible egocentric geometry, ego body footprint, and a hypothetical local action into body-conditioned swept-volume consequences from RGB plus question only, within the currently visible local space.
reference_policy: Use prior spatial, affordance, navigation, and collision benchmarks only as methodology motivation; do not copy their taxonomies, do not keep legacy T1/T2/T3/T4/T5 ids or titles, and do not expose depth, pose, overlays, or navmesh to the evaluated model. Every category must avoid scene-answer leakage, use finite visible-evidence horizons where needed, enforce answer and conditional balance, and report scan/episode coverage to reduce majority, radius-only, action-only, and scene-prior shortcuts.

categories.title: Forward Body Clearance
categories.motivation_link: H1: tests body-relative clearance estimation before first contact for straight ego motion.
categories.r2r_labeling_rule: Compute metric d_safe_m(r,0) by intersecting a radius-r ground-plane swept corridor with R2R depth/pose-derived visible obstacles; convert to d_safe_bw=d_safe_m/(2r) and bin as <2, 2-4, 4-8, or >8 body-widths.
categories.case_acceptance_criteria: Accept only visible-local-space cases with visible_sweep_ratio>=0.7, requires_hidden_geometry=false, ambiguous=false, bin_margin_body_widths>=0.5, stable labels under small oracle perturbations, no fixed image-box depth-quantile GT, no answer-revealing prompt adjectives, category max answer share<=0.40, and scan/episode coverage reported.

categories.title: Action-Horizon Collision
categories.qa_type: yes/no collision within a specified turn-and-forward horizon
categories.motivation_link: H1: tests action-conditioned swept-volume projection rather than central free-space priors.
categories.r2r_labeling_rule: For theta in {-30,-15,15,30} degrees and H in {2,4} body-widths, label collision iff d_safe_bw(r,theta)<H using the radius-r swept-corridor oracle.
categories.case_acceptance_criteria: Require abs(d_safe_bw-H)>=0.5 body-widths, visible_sweep_ratio>=0.7, collision_point_visible=true for collision labels, requires_hidden_geometry=false for no-collision labels, ambiguous=false, no answer-revealing prompt wording, max yes/no answer share<=0.65, conditional balance by theta/H/radius checked, and scan/episode coverage reported.

categories.title: Directional Sweep Ranking
categories.motivation_link: H1: tests multi-action comparison and direction binding by comparing left-front, straight, and right-front swept corridors in the same image.
categories.r2r_labeling_rule: Compute d_safe_bw(r,-30), d_safe_bw(r,0), and d_safe_bw(r,30) up to a shared finite visible_eval_horizon_bw; cap no-contact distances at that validated visible horizon and label the unique largest capped visible distance.
categories.case_acceptance_criteria: All three corridors must satisfy visibility and ambiguity filters; top1-top2>=0.5 body-widths; capped ties are rejected unless a separate tie option is explicitly used; requires_hidden_geometry=false; max answer share<=0.48; direction-conditioned balance checked; and cases spanning multiple scans/episodes reported.

categories.title: Body Counterfactual Flip
categories.qa_type: same-image 3-way body comparison over the same metric action distance
categories.motivation_link: H3: tests whether body radius is used as the collision operator while same RGB, pose, action, and metric movement distance are held fixed.
categories.r2r_labeling_rule: For the same RGB/depth/pose/action and same distance_m, compute d_safe_m for r_small and r_large. Label as both-safe, small-only, or neither-safe according to whether each body can complete distance_m without contact. Exclude only-large-safe as physically impossible under radius monotonicity.
categories.case_acceptance_criteria: Require legal start poses for all radii, metric monotonicity d_safe_m(r_small)>=d_safe_m(r_large) within tolerance, real flip cases where small passes and large fails, no-flip controls where both pass or neither passes, visible large collision for flip cases, sufficient visible small-body corridor evidence, requires_hidden_geometry=false, no body-wording leakage beyond stated radii, max answer share<=0.48 across the three physical labels, and balance across scans/episodes.

categories.title: First-Contact Region
categories.motivation_link: H1 diagnostic: checks whether collision judgments are grounded to visible first-contact evidence rather than only to a yes/no language prior. It is not part of the v1 survival gate.
categories.r2r_labeling_rule: For straight motion up to a finite diagnostic horizon, project the corridor oracle's visible collision_point_3d into the RGB image and bucket it as lower-left, lower-center, or lower-right; use no visible contact only when no visible contact occurs within that horizon.
categories.case_acceptance_criteria: Optional diagnostic only; require collision_point_visible for contact labels, projected pixel sufficiently far from region boundaries, perturbation-stable region assignment, no forced-contact wording, requires_hidden_geometry=false, max answer share<=0.40, and exclusion from core survival-gate counts.
